title: BC Friday Tips #39 Troubleshoot Connectivity
summary: The Troubleshooting Connectivity page helps diagnose connection issues between users' computers and Business Central by checking internet connectivity, Azure CDN resources, user authentication, and service health. Access it by appending '/connectivity' to your Business Central URL.
key_points: A built-in troubleshooting page accessible via '/connectivity' endpoint identifies connection problems
Checks internet connectivity, Azure CDN resources, authentication, and service health status
Helps pinpoint the root cause of Business Central connection failures
Available directly from your Business Central environment without additional tools

quotes.text: The Troubleshooting Connectivity page can help you pinpoint what's causing the issue between your computer and Business Central.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the core purpose of the diagnostic tool for resolving connectivity problems
